name: PartHarbor
description: Search JLCPCB parts and import EasyEDA symbols, footprints and 3D models into KiCad.
description_full: PartHarbor provides a graphical search and import workflow for LCSC/JLCPCB parts. It is based on easyeda2kicad.py and keeps its AGPL-3.0 license and attribution. The toolbar action is available in PCB Editor because KiCad does not currently expose Action Plugins in Schematic Editor.
